summary_ja: 適格金融資産担保を用いる場合の担保権の維持・実行、適時処分の権利と内部手続、マージン・アグリーメントがある場合の管理体制と管理方針、第三者管理時の分別管理の確認を求める。
summary_en: Collateral requirements: perfected and enforceable security, the right and procedures to liquidate promptly, margin-agreement controls covering price, liquidity, concentration, reuse and rehypothecation risks, and segregation by any custodian.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach uses eligible financial collateral as a credit risk mitigation technique, it shall satisfy the conditions of the following items. (i) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has taken all measures necessary to maintain and enforce the security interest relating to the eligible financial collateral. (ii) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has the right, against the counterparty or the custodian managing the eligible financial collateral, to dispose of or acquire the eligible financial collateral in a timely manner when an event allowing enforcement of the security interest occurs. (iii) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has established appropriate internal procedures so that the eligible financial collateral can be disposed of or acquired in a timely manner. (iv) That, where a margin agreement relating to the eligible financial collateral has been concluded, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has established the framework necessary to properly manage additional collateral, has formulated a risk management policy relating to that eligible financial collateral, and has established management policies (including policies on regular management, monitoring and reporting) for all of the following items: (a) The price fluctuation risk and liquidity risk of the securities exchanged as collateral under that contract. (b) Concentration risk in particular types of collateral. (c) Risks arising from the reuse of collateral assets received. (d) The surrender of rights to collateral posted to the counterparty. (v) That, where the management of the eligible financial collateral has been entrusted to a third party, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has confirmed that the custodian manages that eligible financial collateral separately from the custodian's own assets.
